name: ByJTT Design
purpose: Help people and AI create digital products with clear purpose, accessible interactions, and evidence behind important decisions.
recommendedWorkflow: Understand the product goal and users.
Read the relevant parts of the ByJTT Design Standard.
Use or create a Design Contract when important decisions must remain true.
Create or revise the design in Studio when a working interface is useful.
Check accessibility, responsive behaviour, content, interaction states, and implementation reality.
Publish reusable work with its decisions and evidence when appropriate.
rules: Treat /standard.json as the canonical machine-readable Standard index.
Do not infer design requirements from screenshots when an explicit contract or Standard rule exists.
Do not claim verification without recorded evidence.
Prefer established web standards and mature open-source solutions before inventing replacements.
Keep human control clear when AI suggests or executes consequential actions.
